name: Short Drama (Quick Test)
description: Quickly validates the dynamic short drama workflow: story planning, character anchors, storyboard, video, voiceover and automatic composition.

planning.planning_notes: This is a lightweight test flow; formal complex short dramas continue to use the original short-drama Skill. First settle visual_style: fill in the user's intent when the user has confirmed a visual style, and fill in "unspecified" when not confirmed; do not pick a style on your own. A confirmed style must enter every image and video task itself, or be consumed through prompt_for/context_for from an upstream text node containing that style; image-asset edges or Plan inputs alone do not count as passing it on. Every shot item must provide title, prompt and a non-empty narration, where narration is the one line of narration or dialogue actually spoken in that shot.
planning.prompt_guide: Keep character identity, costume, scene and narrative continuous, with each plan item corresponding to one plot shot. A confirmed visual style must be traceable in the visual task's picture prompt or in the upstream text it can consume; when not confirmed, do not impose a style. The prompt describes only the picture, and narration contains only the narration or dialogue actually spoken in that shot, without timecodes, duration, emotion tags, ambient sound, sound effects or music notes.
conduct_rules: Dynamically decide the number of nodes and their dependencies from the user goal
Use only the capabilities declared in allowed_recipe_ids
Generate and confirm the dynamic plan before creating canvas nodes
Do not omit the visual style decision: fill a confirmed style into visual_style and pass it to the visual tasks; fill "unspecified" when not confirmed, and never impose one on your own

input_parameters.label: Confirmed visual style (fill "unspecified" if not confirmed)

rating_bands.description: Fully meets the user goal and the workflow can be executed
Core flow is complete; a few non-critical adjustments are allowed
Missing key stages or incomplete dependencies

domain_constraints: The workflow must match the user goal and keep the input assets consistent
